text: Seed 26's accel_step fit_error (0.2008) sits right at the 0.2 law-recovery threshold. How much does fit_error vary when the symbolic fit is rerun on the same probe output with different subsamples or regressor seeds? If the run-to-run spread is about 0.05 or more, a single fit cannot reliably separate r^-1 from r^-2 near the threshold.
